Definition: apparently another form of G4111 (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity):--smite. Compare G5180.
BiblicalUsage: Plesso means to strike, to smite. It stands once, in Revelation 8:12: the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars, so the day shone not for a third part of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can strike the lights of heaven, and the darkness that follows is His judgment, not His absence.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
